hypothesis: Adding allow-listed project and change-kind filters to the reviewed change feed will let MCP hosts retrieve relevant provenance deterministically as the feed grows, without adding network, write, or semantic-learning authority.
heldOutChecks: library project filtering returns only matching records and reports the full match count before limit
library kind filtering returns only matching records
combined project and kind filtering intersects both constraints
CLI accepts changes [limit] [project] [kind] and reports the applied filters
MCP ruvnet_changes accepts the same allow-listed filters and preserves read-only annotations
unknown projects, unknown kinds, extra filter keys, and unexpected MCP arguments fail closed

memoryDecision.ruvectorWasm: defer until at least 100 sanitized provenance records support a leakage-free comparison against exact project and kind filters
memoryDecision.gnn: reject for the current corpus unless a held-out graph task demonstrates at least ten percentage points of task-success gain over exact filtering

forecast.prediction: Within 60 days, agent change ledgers and capability catalogs will increasingly expose server-side structured filters or stable pagination so hosts can retrieve provenance with deterministic cache keys.
forecast.falsifiableCriterion: By 2026-11-14, at least two primary agent-memory, MCP, or tool-registry implementations newly expose public structured filtering or stable pagination/continuation interfaces for provenance records.
